sourceText:
Blondie Brownies
By: Kate Opatz
Published: Friday, December 10, 2010 - 1:02am

Ingredients




1/2 cup butter flavored Crisco
1 tablespoon milk
1 cup brown sugar, firmly packed
1 Egg
1 cup flour
1/2 teaspoon baking powder
1/8 teaspoon salt
1 teaspoon vanilla
1/2 cup walnuts, chopped

Preparation

1 Preparation Time: 15 minutes 2 Bake Time: 27 to 30 Minutes 3 1. Heat oven to 350 F. Grease an 8x8x2 inch pan with Butter Flavor Crisco. Set aside. 4 2. Combine Butter Flavor Crisco and milk in large saucepan. Place on low heat until Butter Flavor Crisco melts. Remove from heat. Stir in brown sugar. Add egg. Stir until well Blended. 5 3. Combine flour, baking powder and salt. Stir into sugar mixture. 6 Stir in vanilla and nuts. Spread evenly into baking pan. 7 4. Bake at 350 for 27 to 30 minutes, or until a wooden pick inserted into center comes out clean. Cool in pan. Cut into 2x2 inch squares.
